bodyZh.heading: 先了解起點，再決定怎樣學
paragraphs: 想準備留學、重新開始學英文，或尋找 IELTS／TOEFL 輔導時，學生常遇到同一個問題：知道自己想進步，卻說不清楚目前最需要補的是什麼。只有一個舊成績，或一句「英文普通」，也很難讓老師判斷應從哪裡開始。
海外督導 Overseas Tutorial Centre（OTC）推出 OTC English Four-Skills Check，把聽力、閱讀、口說與寫作的初步作答放在同一個工具中。學生可先留下自己的答案與作品，再決定是否需要進一步評閱或課程支援。現在免費開始診斷。

bodyZh.heading: 四項內容，各自看什麼？
paragraphs: 聽力：三段英語音訊，合共 12 題，初步觀察對主要意思與細節的理解。閱讀：三篇短文，合共 12 題，觀察資訊定位與內容理解。聽讀提交作答後可核對結果及解說。
口說：兩個任務，可錄音、播放及下載。寫作：兩項短寫作，包括約 60–90 字電郵及 120–180 字觀點短文。App 保留原稿，不即時評分；完整系統診斷書在後續程序產生。目前不提供人工評閱。

bodyZh.heading: 適合哪些學生？結果如何使用？
paragraphs: 適合暫時沒有近期英文成績、希望了解四項差異、準備與老師討論課程，或需要整理留學前英文學習方向的學生。已有正式考試成績者，也可把作答樣本與原有成績一起提供，讓討論更具體。
例如閱讀答題較順利，但口說難以把原因說完整，下一步可與老師討論口語組織和細節表達；若聽力經常漏掉關鍵資訊，可先討論聽辨與筆記練習。這些是教學討論的方向，仍需結合實際答案及教師判斷。
本工具是初步學習診斷，未經標準化考試效度驗證；結果不能換算為 IELTS、TOEFL 或 CEFR 等級，也不能作為院校入學或語言資格證明。

bodyZh.heading: 使用方法：完成、保存、再討論
paragraphs: ① 開啟工具，預留約 35–45 分鐘，也可以分段完成。按頁面指示填寫需要的資料，可使用暱稱。② 選擇安靜環境，準備耳機及可錄音的裝置；按瀏覽器提示允許麥克風，或使用音訊上傳選項。
③ 用自己目前會的英文完成四項任務，不用翻譯工具、AI 或代答；不會的可以留空。④ 到「我的報告」下載 TXT／JSON 結果，或使用列印功能保存 PDF。口說音檔須另外下載，請在關閉或重新整理頁面前保存。
⑤ 完成後下載 JSON、TXT 及各口說音檔。如需完整診斷，可把資料交給 OTC 的後續系統處理流程。工作台會整理原始資料、初評、複核與引文檢查，再匯出診斷書。這不是網站提交後即時自動生成的服務。閱讀完整指南。

bodyZh.heading: 學生資源匹配：從需求到合適的教學安排
paragraphs: OTC 接受學生與家長的配課諮詢，將初步作答與學習需求一起整理，協助尋找合適的教學支援。配對會考慮目標、目前程度、需加強的技能、年級或學習階段、上課語言、地區／時區、線上或面授偏好、可用時間，以及預算。
聯絡時可先提供：學習目標與預計考試時間、所在地及時區、上課模式、每週可用時段、預算（註明幣種及每堂時長），以及希望加強的技能。有診斷結果可附上；未完成測試也可先諮詢。未成年學生的課程與資料分享安排，需與家長或監護人協調確認。
系統診斷用於整理學習需求，並不自動派課。目前沒有人工評閱服務。師資合作、試教或課程配對需按實際可用資源另行確認，不能把報告視為已有老師接案或已安排課程。

bodyZh.heading: 師資招聘與合作：歡迎提交教學資料
paragraphs: OTC 歡迎英語教學、IELTS／TOEFL 備考及學術英語相關老師提交合作意向。希望合作的老師，請用具體教學經驗說明自己適合支援哪些學生、哪些技能和哪些學習階段；正式考試成績可作背景資料，教學能力仍需透過實際教學說明與示例了解。
請提供：簡歷、可教科目與程度、教學語言、相關學歷／資格及經驗、所在地與時區、線上／面授範圍、可用時段、報價（幣種、課時長度及包含內容），以及匿名化的教學或回饋示例。如提及考試成績，請註明考試及日期；後續核對證明時可先遮去不必要的證件編號。不要提交可識別學生的作業、錄音或聯絡資料。
教學示例可展示如何聽完學生回答、指出具體問題、引導學生補充理由或細節，再透過第二次作答觀察改善。合作討論亦會核對評閱範圍、試教安排、改期及取消方式，並按授課對象與所在地確認所需資格及適用的學生保護要求。提交資料代表合作意向登記；錄用、合作條款、學生配對及課量均須另行確認。

bodyZh.heading: 免費範圍與資料保存
paragraphs: 初步診斷 App 及 Payhip 入門下載包免費。免費自助內容包含短任務、聽讀核對、原稿匯出與指南。完整系統診斷需在另一程序處理，目前不承諾自動即時生成或真人批改；課程合作安排另行確認。
App 不會自動把作答提交給 OTC。文字與選項使用目前瀏覽器的本機儲存，錄音需要另行下載；清除瀏覽器資料或更換裝置可能使本機記錄無法取得。使用共用裝置時，先保存需要的結果，再清除資料。分享報告與音檔前，先確認對象及用途。

bodyZh.heading: 完整系統診斷書樣本與可用性
paragraphs: 虛構 DEMO-01 樣本：聽力 8／12（已答 11）、閱讀 10／12（已答 12）；兩篇寫作 69 及 132 字；未提供口說音檔，不判斷發音、流暢度或口說分數。閱讀完整報告樣本（可列印另存 PDF）。
報告包含資料完整度、四項總覽、寫作逐字證據與分析、口說資料缺口、優先改善項目、兩週學習安排、配課問題、複核紀錄及用途限制。下載原始 JSON · 下載原始 TXT。
開啟系統診斷工作台：匯入原始 JSON → 下載初評工作單交由 ChatGPT 處理 → 匯入初評並下載複核工作單 → 匯入複核結果 → 自動檢查引文、匯出 HTML／JSON，HTML 可列印為 PDF。無需反覆複製貼上原文，但仍需在 ChatGPT 與工作台間交接檔案。
可用性檢查涵蓋資料格式、數字一致性、引文對照、缺資料不評及安全排版。這些功能檢查不等於測驗信效度驗證。樣本明確標為虛構，沒有冒充實際執行的教師或 API 複核。

bodyZh.heading: 學生與老師，從這裡開始
paragraphs: 學生／家長：免費開始診斷，或電郵 office@overseasuk.com，主旨寫「英文學習／學生配課」，並提供目標、時區、時段及預算。
老師：電郵 office@overseasuk.com，主旨寫「英語師資合作」，附上教學背景、可教範圍、可用時段與報價。
更多入口：OTC 學習平台 · Apps & Tools · Payhip 免費入門包。先把需求說清楚，讓下一步學習與教學安排更有依據。

body.heading: Understand your starting point before choosing support
paragraphs: When preparing to study abroad, restarting English or looking for IELTS or TOEFL tuition, it can be difficult to explain what support you need. An old result or a general description of your English may leave important gaps.

OTC English Four-Skills Check brings introductory listening, reading, speaking and writing tasks into one browser-based tool. It helps you collect a starting sample of your work before discussing further review or tuition. Start the free check.

body.heading: What does the check cover?
paragraphs: Listening: 12 questions across three English audio clips. Reading: 12 questions across three short texts. These give an initial view of understanding main ideas and details, with answer checking and explanations after an attempt.

Speaking: two tasks with recording and download. Writing: a 60–90-word email and a 120–180-word opinion response. The app preserves work without immediate grading; a full system diagnostic is produced through a separate workflow. Human review is not currently offered.

body.heading: Who is it for, and how should results be used?
paragraphs: It is suitable for learners without recent English results, those exploring differences across the four skills, and students preparing to discuss tuition or study-abroad language preparation. Existing formal results can be considered alongside the new work samples.

For example, a learner who reads comfortably but struggles to explain reasons aloud may discuss organising spoken answers with a teacher. A learner who misses key listening details may need listening and note-taking practice. These are possible discussion points, subject to review of the actual work.
This is an introductory learning check, not a validated standardised examination. Results cannot be converted into IELTS, TOEFL or CEFR levels or used as admission or language-certification evidence.

body.heading: How to use it: complete, save and discuss
paragraphs: 1. Open the tool and allow around 35–45 minutes, or complete it in stages. You may use a nickname. 2. Find a quiet place and prepare headphones and a recording-capable device. Allow microphone access when prompted, or use the audio upload option.

3. Work independently, without translation tools, AI or someone answering for you. Leave an answer blank if needed. 4. Download your TXT or JSON report from My Report, or print to PDF. Download speaking audio separately before closing or refreshing the page.

5. Download JSON, TXT and each audio file. OTC’s separate system workflow organises original evidence, initial analysis, cross-checking and quotation validation before report export. This is not an instant automated website service. Read the guide.

body.heading: Student matching: from learning needs to teaching arrangements
paragraphs: OTC welcomes student and family enquiries about tuition matching. We consider work samples alongside goals, current learning needs, school stage, teaching language, location and time zone, online or in-person preferences, availability and budget.

Please share your goal and intended exam date, location and time zone, preferred lesson format, weekly availability, budget with currency and lesson duration, and priority skills. Include check results if available; you can enquire before completing it. Arrangements and data sharing for minors need to be coordinated with a parent or guardian.

System diagnosis helps organise learning needs; it does not automatically assign tuition. Human review is not currently offered. Tutor collaboration, trials and lessons depend on actual availability and separate agreement.

body.heading: Tutor recruitment and collaboration enquiries
paragraphs: OTC welcomes expressions of interest from teachers supporting English learning, IELTS or TOEFL preparation and academic English. Please explain which learners, skills and stages you can support through concrete teaching experience. Exam results provide background; teaching examples help us understand how you work.

Please send a CV, subjects and levels taught, teaching languages, relevant qualifications and experience, location and time zone, online or in-person coverage, availability, rates with currency and lesson duration, and an anonymised teaching or feedback example. State the test and date for any exam results. Unnecessary identity numbers can be redacted from evidence requested later. Do not include identifiable student work, recordings or contact details.

A useful example shows how you listen to a complete response, identify specific needs, guide the learner to add reasons or detail, and check a second attempt. Discussions also cover review scope, trial teaching, rescheduling and cancellation, and qualifications and applicable safeguarding requirements for the teaching context. Submitting details is an expression of interest; engagement, terms, student matching and teaching hours require separate confirmation.

body.heading: Free access and saving your work
paragraphs: The introductory app and access pack are free. Self-service tasks, listening and reading checks, original-work exports and the guide are included. A full system report requires a separate workflow; instant automatic generation and human marking are not offered. Teaching arrangements are agreed separately.

The app does not automatically submit your answers to OTC. Text and choices use local browser storage; recordings need separate downloads. Clearing browser data or changing devices may make local work unavailable. On a shared device, save what you need and then clear your work. Confirm the recipient and purpose before sharing reports or audio.

body.heading: Detailed system report sample and workflow
paragraphs: DEMO-01 is fictional: listening 8/12 with 11 answered, reading 10/12 with 12 answered, writing samples of 69 and 132 words, and no speaking audio. Read the detailed report sample (Chinese-led; print-to-PDF available).

The report includes evidence completeness, original writing with quoted feedback, missing speaking evidence, priorities, a two-week plan, matching questions and actual processing records. Download original JSON · Download TXT.

The system diagnostic workbench prepares files for initial analysis and cross-checking in ChatGPT, validates imported quotations and exports HTML/JSON reports. File handover is required; this is not unattended website generation.

Functional tests cover input consistency, quotation checks, missing evidence and safe rendering; they do not establish examination validity. The fictional sample does not claim actual API or human review.

body.heading: Start here: students and tutors
paragraphs: Students and families: start the free check or email office@overseasuk.com with the subject “English Tuition Matching”. Include your goal, time zone, availability and budget.
Tutors: email office@overseasuk.com with the subject “English Tutor Collaboration”, including your background, teaching scope, availability and rates.
Explore the OTC Learning Platform, Apps & Tools or free Payhip access pack. Clear needs and concrete work samples make the next teaching conversation more useful.
